title: Hospitable Review, Pricing & Alternatives (2026)
summary: Hospitable review for 2026: AI suggested and auto replies, a free tier, no phone product, and the best Hospitable alternatives for growing portfolios.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated September 3, 2026.*


Hospitable is short-term rental automation built around Airbnb-first messaging, with AI that suggests and auto-sends replies. It has a free tier and four plans, though the prices do not render on its own pricing page. There is no phone product. It is a good fit for hosts whose problem is message consistency, and the wrong fit if the problem is resolution.


## What is Hospitable?


Hospitable automates the operating rhythm of a short-term rental: scheduled guest messages across the OTAs, calendar and reservation sync, team tasks, and direct booking. Its AI features are named as Message AI Assistant, AI Suggested Replies, AI Auto Reply that routes messages by topic or workflow tag, an AI Copilot that reads booking data for insights, and automated Q&A detection.


The product's centre of gravity is message quality and timing. It writes well-toned messages and sends them at the right moment in the stay. That is a different job from reading an unexpected question and finishing the task behind it.


## How much does Hospitable cost?


Hospitable publishes four tiers: Essentials (free), Host, Professional, and Mogul, the last marked best value. On the pricing page we checked, the figures for the three paid tiers did not render, showing placeholders instead, so treat the exact numbers as unconfirmed and check the live page for your listing count. It notes prices exclude VAT where applicable and offers roughly 12% savings on annual billing.


For comparison among tools that do publish clearly: Visito starts at $99/month, Jurny publishes $19 per unit with a $400 monthly minimum, and Conduit publishes $18 per unit per month for Messaging up to $48 for Full Suite. Hostaway, Akia, HelloShift, Asksuite, Bookboost, and Operto publish nothing.


## What is Hospitable good at?


- **Message tone and scheduling.** Consistently well-written guest messages fired at the right stay milestones, which is the job most hosts hire it for.
- **A genuine free tier.** Essentials at no cost is an unusually low barrier to starting.
- **Airbnb-first depth.** Built around how Airbnb hosting actually works rather than retrofitted to it.
- **AI Auto Reply with routing.** Topic and workflow tags give you a control surface rather than a single on/off switch.


## Where does Hospitable fall short?


- **No phone product.** No published AI voice, so calls are not covered.
- **Suggestion over resolution.** Suggested replies and auto-replies are not the same as an agent that changes a reservation or completes a request in your systems.
- **Pricing did not render.** Tier names are published; the numbers were not visible on the page we checked.
- **Single-brand shape.** It is built for a host or a manager, not for reusing one configuration across several brands with local exceptions.


## Who should pick something else?


Hospitable is a strong default for hosts and small managers whose pain is that messages are inconsistent, late, or manual. If that is the whole problem, it may be all you need, and it is cheaper than a platform.


Three things break the fit. Guests calling an unanswered phone need voice, which Hospitable does not have. Needing the agent to finish the task, extending a stay or applying a fee or resetting an access code, rather than write a good message about it, is a different category of product. Past a couple of hundred doors or a second brand, the reuse question starts to dominate everything else.

## FAQ


### Does Hospitable have AI?


Yes. It names Message AI Assistant, AI Suggested Replies, AI Auto Reply with topic and workflow routing, an AI Copilot for booking data, and automated Q&A detection.


### Does Hospitable answer phone calls?


No. There is no AI voice or phone product on its pricing page, so calls still reach a person.


### Is Hospitable free?


There is a free Essentials tier. The three paid tiers are Host, Professional, and Mogul, with roughly 12% savings on annual billing and prices excluding VAT where applicable.


### What is the difference between Hospitable and a guest AI agent?


Hospitable is strongest at sending the right message at the right time and suggesting replies. An agent layer is judged on whether it resolves the request end to end, including changing the reservation. Ask any vendor to show write-back, not just integration.


### What is the best Hospitable alternative for a growing portfolio?


The question that sorts them is whether adding the two-hundredth listing is a configuration or a rebuild, and whether the phone is covered. Besty and HostBuddy stay in messaging; Conduit adds voice on the same agent plus PMS write-back.
